Name: Max Cast Stamina
Author: StultusVMods
Description:
A friend of mine said that they thought you shouldn't lose any stamina for casting a fishing line if you get the bar maxed out. I agreed, so I made this very small mod. As long as the big "MAX" sign appears above your bar, it shouldn't take any stamina to cast that line. I also added a config option to manually set the amount of stamina restored (can be set with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ or in the config.json file after running the mod at least once)

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
No setup is needed. Simply start fishing, and you'll see that when you hit a max fishing cast, you shouldn't lose any stamina!

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size]

[/list]
